rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=1.0, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-2 INIT_T lever, breast-native wdm-wavelet UNCONSTRAINED (DC OFF, fd_recon_dc=0). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-1 (init_t=0.7) hr=0.0, calibrated masked rmse=0.02248, psnr=23.63, ssim=0.856 -- prior regenerates too much at high embed time, drifts above the calibrated FBP floor. (2) Failure mode: at init_t=0.7 the FBP warm-start is embedded deep in noise so the few-step flow reconstructs mostly from the prior; with the hard CG DC projection OFF only DPS soft-guidance enforces the sinogram -> under-constrained, RMSE too high. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_init_t 0.7->0.4 (retain more FBP structure), all else identical. (4) HYPOTHESIS: lower init_t keeps more of the strong 128-view FBP so calibrated RMSE drops toward the floor; the DC-on sibling found t=0.4 best, so this is the fair single-knob comparison. If hr still 0, prior-alone (no DC) is structurally below the calibrated FBP baseline -- the intended finding. (5) BUDGET: iter-1 ran <5min. (6) Loop continues.
